decisions.reason: As a core upholstery fabric very close to the established range and still important for the firm's broad collection, it remains more valuable to keep than to rationalize.
Its flame-retardant specification serves contract and hospitality customers well and gives it a clear functional role in a growing interior-textiles market.
Its niche decorative positioning, wool-blend construction and weaker prominence versus the firm's core and more functional lines make it the most likely product to be removed in portfolio cleanup.
As a recently launched fabric with versatile use in both upholstery and curtains and a dedicated presentation, it deserves more time on the market before any withdrawal decision.
